title: Michigan NGL depropanizer: reach the guaranteed rate without feed-zone flooding
source: Golden and Martin, Oil & Gas Journal, 25 August 2003; original tower, feed and first-test evidence only
question: Raise depropanizer capacity from about 25,000 to the 30,500 b/d guarantee while preserving propane quality. Which section limits, and what internals/feed-zone design is robust?
data_note: Real Michigan NGL depropanizer revamp and troubleshooting history. The article publishes pressure, old packing depth/performance, capacity, feed composition range and product-purity observations, but not a full hydrocarbon assay. Any DWSIM C2/C3/C4 feed and b/d conversion are explicit scale assumptions. Later tray/feed-zone changes and performance are withheld.
suggested_questions: Which section backs up first near 28,000 b/d?
How should the feed enter a tightly spaced tray section?
Can the target hold across the documented feed-composition range?
